summary: CID HoldCo filed an 8-K disclosing an unsecured convertible promissory note issued September 10, 2026 to H Capital Ventures Management Consultancies Co. LLC of the UAE, tied to a September 14, 2026 binding term sheet with BladeRanger and Envoy. Principal is $550,000 with $500,000 cash funded, a 10% original issue discount, and 8% interest accruing and guaranteed for six months. Conversion is at the lower of $1.50 or 90% of the 10-day VWAP, floored at $0.50, capped by a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership limit and a 9.99% exchange cap. Watch dilution, floor pricing, and any stockholder approval needed to lift the exchange cap.
